newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-CROATIAN STRIKER STANIC OUT FOR SIX WEEKS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-CROATIAN STRIKER STANIC OUT FOR SIX WEEKS.

text.p: Croatian striker Mario Stanic will be out of action for around six weeks after injuring his right knee in midweek, his Italian club Parma said on Friday.

Stanic, who has quickly become one of Parma's key players since arriving in Italy this season, has already been ruled out of Croatia's World Cup qualifiers at home to Denmark on Saturday and neighbours Slovenia next week.
The club, currently second in serie A six points behind Juventus, had been hoping for a far shorter absence.
But an arthroscopy performed on the right knee on Friday showed a partial tear of the cruciate ligament.
